title: One body, six parts, one invoice.
lede: Buy a part, you get a product. Buy the whole, you get Verax. The brain inside the head changes; the body keeps the record.
head.q: Was this still true that day?
head.what: Dated memory. Every entry knows when it was true and when it went stale.
head.status: on npm and the MCP Registry
face.q: What did it do to the company?
face.what: The human surface: cockpit, watch, mirror. A separate product; enters the bundle as a tool.
core.q: Did this action pass the gate?
core.what: Every tool call passes here. Allow or deny is signed before the call goes out. No record, no action.
hands.what: Payment and decision records. Do both ledgers say the same thing?
hands.status: 0.13.0 on npm; IETF drafts; Zenodo DOI
torso.what: Measures whether the record is complete. Every link of the spine in place.
ground.q: Was it within the rules? Contest it.
ground.what: The rule the body stands on. Decision review and the right to contest.
whole.q: Five questions, one ledger, one invoice.
whole.what: Whatever brain drives it, every action carries a receipt, every payment reconciles, every decision is on record.
